 Holiday Season & Christmas Home Depot’s Black Friday sale has started early — get up to 65% off holiday decor, power tools and more 
 Plus, get deals on storage items, appliances and smart home tech that’ll come in handy when family is visiting. Nov. 5, 2026, 2:50 PM EST Cory Fernandez
 Commerce Editor
 Home Depot’s Black Friday sale is a great opportunity to save on home essentials ahead of Christmas. 
 Kara Birnbaum / NBC Home Depot’s Black Friday sale has already begun, and the retailer has tons of deals worth celebrating. While Black Friday is still a few weeks away, you don’t have to wait to save on home essentials ahead of the holidays. 
 Home Depot’s sale is offering up to 65 percent off storage bins and organizational items, small and large home appliances, power tools, holiday decorations and much more. Plus, you can save on reliable and trusted brands , like Milwaukee , Husky , Ring and Home Decorators Collection . 
 As a home editor who covers appliances, storage, home improvement, decor and sales at Home Depot, I know how to find good deals at the retailer. Below, I rounded up some of the best deals so far, and I’ll continue to update this list throughout the sale through Black Friday.

 Ring Battery Doorbell 2K and Indoor Cam Plus 2K 
 $ 59.99 $ 139.99 Home Depot Now 57% off $ 59.99 $ 159.98 Amazon Now 63% off $ 59.99 $ 139.99 Best Buy Now 57% off Keep your home safe and maintain some peace of mind with this ultra-popular battery doorbell set from Ring, which is an NBC Selected editor-favorite home appliance brand. The set includes a high-definition video doorbell that alerts when there’s someone at your front door, such as visitors or the mail delivery person. You can communicate with people in front of the doorbell remotely. Plus, it includes an indoor camera that can mount on the wall in your home, which is great for keeping an eye on pets. 
 Shark Navigator Lift-Away DLX Corded
Upright Vacuum Cleaner 
 $ 149.00 $ 199.00 Home Depot Now 25% off $ 149.99 $ 199.99 Amazon Now 25% off $ 149.99 $ 199.99 Best Buy Now 25% off This is one of the most popular upright vacuums you can buy. It comes with a crevice tool for cleaning around furniture and a pet multi-tool which is great for cleaning up pet hair and dust on upholstery. The top of the vacuum cleaner also detaches and it includes a 16-inch extension tool, so you can use it as a portable appliance when cleaning areas like a staircase, shelf or elevated window frame. 
 Milwaukee M12/M18 Lithium-Ion Cordless Impact Wrench Combo Kit 
 $ 299.00 $ 499.00 Home Depot Now 40% off Milwaukee is one of the best power tool brands available, and many of its products are bestsellers at Home Depot. This kit includes a brushless, high-torque impact wrench, an M12 lithium battery, a charger for both M12 and M18 batteries, an M12 ratchet and a contractor bag to carry it all. The impact wrench has up to 800 pounds of torque and has a built-in LED light to illuminate what you’re working on, which can help prevent accidents. 
 BETA We can help you find
 Veikous 6-foot Prelit Slim Artificial Christmas Tree 
 $ 69.60 $ 89.98 Home Depot Now 23% off Don’t wait to put up your Christmas tree — now is a perfect time to start decorating around your home, starting with this affordable artificial tree . Available in 6- and 7.5-foot options, the tree has a slender silhouette, so it could work well in a small home, as a complimentary Christmas tree to your main one or one you keep in the foyer, entryway or even a bedroom. In total, the tree has 250 warm white LED lights. 
 Husky 94-Piece Mechanics Tool Set
 $ 49.97 $ 84.97 Home Depot Now 41% off This all-inclusive tool set from Husky, which would make a great holiday gift for the home improvement enthusiast in your life, comes with two ratchets, 41 standard sockets, 12 deep sockets, two types of adapters and extensions and more than 30 other tools, including a screwdriver and hex keys. Plus, the pieces are made from rust-resistant chrome, according to the brand and it all comes in a carrying case. You can also get the case with 75 or 119 pieces inside. 
 HDX 27-Gallon Storage Bin Set 
 $ 67.47 $ 79.98 Home Depot Now 16% off HDX storage bins are a major bestseller at Home Depot, likely because they’re sturdy and stackable, making them easy to store. This set includes four 27-gallon, plastic storage bins, which would be great for seasonal apparel, sports equipment, shoes and stowing away holiday decorations when the time comes. They could also hold a great deal of water if you needed to fill them for an emergency. Each of the water-resistant bins has a lid that snaps closed. They are also available in clear, so you can see what’s inside if you have them stacked in a garage for the season. 
 LG Smart Front-Load Washer and Dryer Set
 $ 1,558.00 $ 2,598.00 Home Depot Now 40% off $ 1,999.00 $ 2,899.00 LG Electronics Now 31% off $ 1,899.00 $ 2,699.00 Home Depot Now 30% off If you really want to surprise a loved one this holiday season, this washer and dryer set from LG is just the thing. Perfect for anyone moving into a new home or planning on upgrading a fixer upper, this set is equipped with smart features, like Smart Pairing, which customizes the drying cycle while the clothes are still in the washer. 
 The set includes a washer with several cycle options, including an allergen cycle that uses steam to get rid of allergens like pollen and dust, according to the brand. It also has a Turbo Wash function, which uses high-speed water jets to thoroughly clean clothes. The dryer is also available in three types: gas, electric and heat pump. The set has a 10-year limited warranty.
